MIBR (also known as Made in Brazil) is a Brazilian professional esports organization owned by Spun Media.

  • June 7th - The MIBR brand is revived by Immortals. [1]
  • June 23rd - MIBR acquire the roster of SK Gaming consisting of FalleN, fer, coldzera, boltz, Stewie2K, and Swani, the latter as an analyst. [2][3]
  • July 14th - MIBR bench boltz and sign tarik as his replacement. [4]
  • July 15th - MIBR parts ways with Swani. [5]
  • August 1st - MIBR sign YNk as coach. [6]
  • November 30th - MIBR release boltz. [7]
  • December 21st - MIBR and Team Liquid trade Stewie2K for TACO and zews as YNk is benched. [8]
  • December 31st - MIBR release YNk following the expiration of his contract. [9]
  • January 12th - MIBR bench tarik and acquire felps from INTZ eSports as his replacement. [10]
  • February 28th - tarik is acquired by NRG Esports. [11]
  • June 25th - MIBR and Luminosity Gaming trade felps for LUCAS1 on loan. [12]
  • July 12th - MIBR bench coldzera. [13]
  • September 5th - MIBR acquire kNgV- from INTZ eSports. [14]
  • September 12th - MIBR sign LUCAS1 on permanent basis as Luminosity Gaming release their team. [15]
  • September 25th - coldzera is acquired by FaZe Clan. [16]
  • December 11th - MIBR part ways with LUCAS1 and acquire meyern from Sharks Esports as his replacement. [17][18]
  • January 6th - MIBR loan felps to Team oNe eSports. [19]
  • January 31st - felps returns to MIBR's bench as his loan to Team oNe eSports is terminated. [20]
  • February 24th - MIBR loan felps to BOOM Esports. [21]
  • March 25th - MIBR part ways with zews; dead takes over the coaching role. [22]
  • May 19th - MIBR bench meyern and acquire trk from Team oNe eSports as his replacement. [23][24]
  • June 28th - meyern is acquired by 9z Team. [25]
  • August 6th - felps is acquired by BOOM Esports. [26]
  • August 31st - MIBR suspend dead pending an investigation following his ban from ESL and DreamHack. [27]
  • September 13th - MIBR bench fer, TACO, and dead. Due to that, FalleN also requests to be benched from the lineup. [28][29]
  • October 21st - MIBR sign cogu as the team's coach and manager. [30]
  • October 23rd - MIBR sign LUCAS1, and acquire leo_drk and v$m on loan from Sharks Esports and DETONA Gaming, respectively, until the end of the year. [31]
  • October 28th - MIBR release dead. [32]
  • December 1st - MIBR release fer following the expiration of his contract. [33]

  • January 9th - FalleN is acquired by Team Liquid. [41]
  • January 14th - MIBR sign nak as the team's strategic coach and a content creator. [42]
  • January 15th - MIBR sign danoco and acquire the roster of BOOM Esports consisting of boltz, shz, chelo, yel, and Apoka as coach. [43]

  • May 1st - MIBR part ways with kNgV- and trk. [45][46]
